headline: Nigeria Oil Production Averages 1.69M Barrels Per Day in Q3
summary: Nigeria pumped about 1.69 million barrels a day in the third quarter of 2026, staying at or above its OPEC quota for the sixth straight month.
why: Crude production volumes dictate export revenues and national compliance with international cartel quotas.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Sustained oil extraction output supports government foreign exchange earnings and export performance.
